comparison.objective: Pour mixed coins from a jar and sort pennies and quarters into separate marked regions.
comparison.physical_skill: Container pouring followed by individual nonprehensile discrimination and planar pushing.
comparison.success_condition: Credit per coin wholly inside its denomination's target frame; wrong-frame, out-of-frame, or jar-retained coins do not count.
comparison.reason: Although both tasks separate mixed rigid bodies, this record tests semantic sorting by repeated planar pushes; the candidate tests simultaneous geometry-based screening, retention, agitation, and screen replacement.
